claude.label: Claude Code
claude._notes: model: any name `claude --model` accepts (sonnet, opus, haiku). billing 'subscription' removes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from runs so Claude Code uses your Claude plan; set 'api' to bill an API key instead.

usage.note: Claude Code reports a cost estimate per headless run. The meter shows this week's total against the budget you set here. It is not your plan's real limit.
